//: ⛔ NO "type": "module". Docusaurus emits a CommonJS server bundle and evaluates it during SSR; with "type": "module" that bundle is parsed as ESM and the build dies on `require.resolveWeak is not a function` AFTER webpack reports both compilations green — measured, not guessed. This is why eslint.config.mjs carries its extension, and why vitest warns that its config uses ESM syntax in a CommonJS file (cosmetic: vitest transpiles it; the file must stay `vitest.config.ts` because vitestTempRoot.test.ts globs `vitest*.config.ts` and would go blind on any other extension).
